findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_value, post_map · Private data: explain_move, get_funding, get_order_flow, market_snapshot, perp_dashboard, options_chain, carry_pressure, market_rotation, route_order, execution_window, exit_capacity, position_limits, currency_leg, leg_rates, post_value, post_map, fetch_series, test_formula, save_strategy · Public sink: post_value, post_map, test_formula · Destructive: execution_window, fetch_series, test_formula.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_value, post_map · Private data: explain_move, get_funding, get_order_flow, market_snapshot, perp_dashboard, options_chain, carry_pressure, market_rotation, route_order, execution_window, exit_capacity, position_limits, currency_leg, leg_rates, post_value, post_map, fetch_series, test_formula, save_strategy · Public sink: post_value, post_map, test_formula · Destructive: execution_window, fetch_series, test_formula

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
